response.sql: WITH actor_counts AS (SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS actor_count FROM film_actor GROUP BY film_id), first_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM actor_counts), first_pass AS (SELECT ac.film_id, ac.actor_count, ac.actor_count - fa.avg_count AS excess_first FROM actor_counts ac CROSS JOIN first_average fa WHERE ac.actor_count > fa.avg_count), second_average AS (SELECT AVG(actor_count) AS avg_count FROM first_pass) SELECT SUM(fp.actor_count) AS total_actor_count, AVG(fp.excess_first) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(fp.actor_count - sa.avg_count) AS avg_excess_second FROM first_pass fp CROSS JOIN second_average sa WHERE fp.actor_count > sa.avg_count
